talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $23.8M sold across 14 Form D filings this week, down 77% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was OH3 Apts Holdings LLC (Troy, Commercial) targeting $6.7M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

Trimas Corp (TRS) closed a transaction with Takeoff Buyer, Inc.. It was one of 3 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan manufacturing & automotive assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

10 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $9.4M raised so far — led by Beckett Industries CPG Fund I, LP (Other Investment Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
